intro.text: A swordsman whom Vasher killed in a duel in Yarn Dred, even though Arsteel was the better fighter of the two.
One of the Five Scholars and the brother of Yesteel, a skilled swordsman whom Vasher killed in a duel in Yarn Dred.

items.text: Arsteel was one of the Five Scholars, together with Vasher, Denth, Shashara and his brother Yesteel, and probably studied Awakening with them.
Though Arsteel was the stronger swordsman, Vasher killed him in a duel in Yarn Dred.
Vasher won by suddenly pouring a large amount of Breath into him. The rush of it overwhelmed Arsteel for a moment, and that was long enough for Vasher to kill him.
